title: Provision — VTA Redeem — payload
description: The claimant polls the Farm, with the key that made the claim, for the outcome of its claim on a reservation. Each poll is a freshly signed document carrying the handle. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: Provision — VTA Redeem — response payload
Response.description: The hand-over, signed by the Farm's assertionMethod key and sent only once the claimant's key is written into the VTA as its administrator and the VTA answers: which VTA, what the claim did, and where the VTA is reachable. Every earlier state is a `trust-task-error` (`pending`, `rejected`, or a family code), never this document.

vtaDid.description: The DID of the VTA the claimant now administers. The Farm chooses the DID method; the VTA Farm issues `did:webvh`.

operation.description: What the claim did. `provisionVta`: the claimant is the first administrator of a VTA provisioned for this reservation. `grantAcl`: the claimant was added as an administrator of a VTA that already had one. The Farm derives it from the reservation; the wallet never chooses it.

mediatorDid.description: The DID of the DIDComm mediator the VTA is reachable through. A convenience: the wallet can also read it from the VTA's own DID document.

didLogUrl.description: Where the VTA's DID log is served. For `did:webvh` it is the `did.jsonl` URL the DID itself encodes. An `https` URL with no userinfo.
